en: Psalms 80
For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph.

zh: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。

ja: 指揮者のために。「契約のゆり」の調べに合わせて。アサフの詩。

p.src: 1  Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

ja: よ、聞いてください。 ヨセフを
en: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
u.src: 1  Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

p.src: 2  Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

ja: エフライム、ベニヤミン、マナセの
こしてください。 私たちを救うために来てください。
en: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
u.src: 2  Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

p.src: 3  Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

ja: らせてください。 あなたの
かせてください。 そうすれば、
en: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
u.src: 3  Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

p.src: 4  LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

ja: よ、 あなたはいつまで、あなたの
en: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
u.src: 4  LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

p.src: 5  You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

ja: べさせ、 あふれるほどの
en: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
u.src: 5  You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

p.src: 6  You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

ja: たちの敵は自分たちの間で嘲り
en: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
u.src: 6  You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

p.src: 7  Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

ja: らせてください。 あなたの
かせてください。 そうすれば、
en: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
u.src: 7  Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

p.src: 8  You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

ja: あなたはエジプトからぶどうの
en: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
u.src: 8  You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

p.src: 9  You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

ja: あなたはそれのために
を空けられ、 それは
en: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
u.src: 9  You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

p.src: 10  The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

ja: は神の杉の木のようであった。
en: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
u.src: 10  The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

p.src: 11  It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

en: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
u.src: 11  It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

p.src: 12  Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

ja: るすべての者がそれを
en: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
u.src: 12  Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

p.src: 13  The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

en: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
u.src: 13  The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

p.src: 14  Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

ja: ください。このぶどうの
en: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
u.src: 14  Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

p.src: 15  the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

ja: えられたその幹を、 あなたがご
en: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
u.src: 15  the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

p.src: 16  It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

en: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
u.src: 16  It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

p.src: 17  Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

ja: に、あなたの御手がありますように。
en: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
u.src: 17  Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

p.src: 18  So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

ja: たちはあなたから離れ去ることはない。
かしてください。そうすれば、
en: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
u.src: 18  So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

p.src: 19  Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

ja: らせてください。 あなたの
かせてください。そうすれば、
en: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
u.src: 19  Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
